summary: B&G Foods filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a $475 million private offering of 11.00% senior notes due 2031, priced at 97.67% of face value, to redeem its $509.3 million 5.25% senior notes due 2027. The notes are unregistered and issued under an indenture with BNY Mellon as trustee. Interest is payable semi-annually starting December 15, 2026; redemption prices step down from 105.5% after June 2028 to par after June 2030, with a 40% make-whole call at 111% prior. This is a routine refinancing—no special-situation event—focused on extending debt maturity and reducing near-term obligations. What to watch: execution of the redemption and any impact on liquidity given the higher coupon.
